claims.claim_text: Linde reports 2025 total sales of $33,986 million (3% above 2024), with hydrogen disclosed as a primary process gas across all three geographic segments via SMR, ATR, low-carbon (blue) and renewable (green) electrolyzer pathways.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.object_value: $33,986M FY2025; hydrogen produced via SMR/ATR/blue/green pathways
claims.source_quote: Linde s sales were $33,986 million, $33,005 million, and $32,854 million for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively... Hydrogen is produced from several different feedstocks using a range of technologies... Linde has a range of technologies to produce low-carbon hydrogen from fossil feedstocks, or renewable hydrogen from renewable energy (non-fossil feedstock).

claims.claim_text: Linde owns and operates five major hydrogen-capable pipeline complexes in North America (northern Indiana, Houston, Gulf Coast of Texas, Detroit, and Louisiana) supplying on-site / tonnage customers under 10-20 year total-requirement contracts.
claims.subject: Linde Americas
claims.object_value: 5 North American pipeline complexes; 10-20 year on-site contracts
claims.source_quote: There are five major pipeline complexes in North America located in northern Indiana, Houston, along the Gulf Coast of Texas, Detroit and Louisiana... On-site product supply contracts generally are total requirement contracts with terms typically ranging from 10-20 years and containing minimum purchase requirements and price escalation provisions.

claims.claim_text: Linde operates approximately 350 production facilities in the Americas (primarily cryogenic air separation plants, hydrogen plants and carbon dioxide plants).
claims.subject: Linde Americas
claims.source_quote: The Americas segment operates production facilities primarily in the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Brazil, approximately 350 of which are mainly cryogenic air separation plants, hydrogen plants and carbon dioxide plants.

claims.claim_text: Linde holds a portfolio of proprietary patents covering hydrogen, synthesis gas, air separation and clean-energy technologies (R&D centers in Pullach Germany, Tonawanda NY, Burr Ridge IL, Shanghai).
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.object_value: Patents in hydrogen / SMR / air-separation / clean energy
claims.source_quote: Linde owns or licenses a large number of patents that relate to a wide variety of products and processes... Research and development is primarily conducted in Pullach, Germany, Tonawanda, New York, Burr Ridge, Illinois and Shanghai, China.

claims.claim_text: Linde anticipates continued growth in 'clean hydrogen' (blue + green H2) sales driven by decarbonization demand, with capability to produce green hydrogen via electrolysis using renewable energy and water.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.object_value: Forward-looking clean H2 (blue + green) growth; electrolyzer production capability
claims.source_quote: Linde anticipates continued growth in clean hydrogen sales due to increased focus on decarbonization projects... Renewable (green) hydrogen is produced by electrolysis using renewable energy and water as feedstock.

claims.claim_text: Linde records a $1.2B contingent liability tied to advance payments on terminated Russian engineering projects with RusChemAlliance (RCA) and a $0.7B contingent liability for the Amur GPP matter with Gazprom; total ~$1.9B Russia-related liabilities recorded as of Dec 31 2025.
claims.subject: Linde Engineering
claims.object_value: $1.2B RCA contingent liability + $0.7B Amur GPP contingent liability ($1.9B combined)
claims.source_quote: Linde does not expect a material adverse impact on earnings given the combined $1.9 billion liabilities recorded as of December 31, 2025... As of December 31, 2025, Linde has a contingent liability of $1.2 billion, which represents advance payments previously recorded in contract liabilities related to terminated engineering projects with RCA... As of December 31, 2025, Linde has a contingent liability of $0.7 billion for this and other Amur GPP contract matters.

claims.claim_text: Linde repurchased $7.7B of ordinary shares under the October 2023 $15B buyback program through Dec 31 2025; $7.3B remains authorized.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.object_value: $7.7B repurchased of $15B program; $7.3B remaining; $4,578M net repurchases in 2025
claims.source_quote: On October 23, 2023, the company's board of directors approved the repurchase of $15 billion of its ordinary shares ('2023 program')... As of December 31, 2025, the company repurchased $7.7 billion of its ordinary shares pursuant to the 2023 program. As of December 31, 2025, $7.3 billion of share repurchases remain authorized under the 2023 program.
